methods.population: Separate complete four-pass cohorts for fresh and warm, per target/cell; no partial four-pass Objects. Warm requires both planned warm repeats in each epoch and identity continuity from its first turn; an excluded fresh turn alone does not exclude valid warm turns.
methods.objectMedian: Median of all retained same-build turns per Object: two fresh turns or four warm turns. Repeated-pass spreads separately use each pass median.
methods.pairedRatio: Per-Object candidate median / baseline median, then distribution across Objects; Pi uses the same position labels with unchanged source bundle.
methods.repeatedSpread: Per Object: absolute difference between repeated same-build pass medians; relative = 100*(max/min-1). Signed later/earlier drift is also retained.
methods.yieldedOverPi: Ratio of target medians of complete-Object build medians; separately includes matched logical Object-index ratios, not the same physical DO.
methods.quantiles: Linear interpolation at (n-1)*q. All latency values are milliseconds; ratios are dimensionless.
methods.receiptAdmission: Yielded-only driver-observed submit-to-receipt latency, already included in full driverMs; no Pi receipt metric.
methods.proof: Rechecks raw reset/build/isolate/incarnation/counters, complete pass membership and cross-target transcript fingerprints. Individual provider receipts are not in this JSON; their verification relies on the saved controller flag.
methods.limits: Fresh full-turn latency is not Worker module-initialization time. Repeated passes share Objects and histories grow in ABBA order. Descriptive sample spreads are not confidence intervals.

cpuObservations.note: All observed non-ok outcomes retained, including intentional cold-abort exceptions; no missing telemetry is inferred as zero.

findings: No consistent full-turn Yielded improvement is resolved across cells; unchanged Pi also improves in candidate-position fresh passes.
Strict complete-four-pass fresh cohorts contain 76 Yielded and 69 Pi Objects out of 80 each. Warm cohorts contain 80 Yielded and 77 Pi Objects. Partial four-pass Objects are excluded per state.
Fresh Yielded receipt-admission paired medians improve 4.2–15.1%, while median same-build repeated-pass relative spreads are 12.5–27.4%; no Pi receipt-admission metric exists.
All 2560 planned turns are terminal: 2525 ok and 35 excluded (26 fresh, 3 warmup, 6 warm). No execution failures or independent evidence mismatches; cleanup verified.
CPU observations retain all non-ok outcomes separately, including intentional cold-abort outcomes and 490 unmatched markers; these are not counted as failed measured turns.
This measures complete fresh turns, not Cloudflare Worker module-initialization time.
